title: LLM4Rerank: LLM-based Auto-Reranking Framework for Recommendations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating recommendation fairness by calculating the Mean Absolute Difference (MAD) in average ranking scores between distinct item groups segregated by specific features, such as movie release year (pre-1996 vs. post-1996), video duration (less than vs. greater than 60,000 ms), and movie language.
